mapper.update: UPDATE wkf_inventory_item SET inventory_status_enum = IF(inventory_status_enum = 'ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'ACTIVE') WHERE id in #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT inv.id, inv.item_table AS itemTable, inv.item_id AS itemId, inv.name, inv.py_str AS pyStr, inv.wb_str AS wbStr, inv.lot_number AS lotNumber, inv.quantity AS totalVolume, inv.location_id AS warehouseId, inv.supplier_id AS supplierId, inv.expiration_date AS expirationDate, inv.production_date AS productionDate, inv.inventory_status_enum AS inventoryStatusEnum, inv.trace_no AS traceNo, inv.category_code AS medicationCategoryCode, DATEDIFF(inv.expiration_date, CURDATE()) AS remainingDays, loc.name AS warehouseName, sup.name AS supplierName, /* ---- 药品/器械定义表冗余字段 ---- */ COALESCE(med.bus_no, dev.bus_no) AS productBusNo, COALESCE(med.merchandise_name, dev.merchandise_name) AS merchandiseName, COALESCE(med.manufacturer_text, dev.manufacturer_text) AS manufacturer, COALESCE(med.approval_number, dev.approval_number) AS approvalNumber, COALESCE(med.yb_no, dev.yb_no) AS ybNo, COALESCE(med.chrgitm_lv, dev.chrgitm_lv) AS chrgitmLv, COALESCE(med.category_code, dev.category_code) AS deviceCategoryCode, med.dose_form_code AS doseFormCode, COALESCE(med.package_unit_code, dev.package_unit_code) AS packageUnitCode, COALESCE(med.split_unit_code, dev.split_unit_code) AS splitUnitName, COALESCE(med.package_unit_ratio, dev.package_unit_ratio) AS packageUnitRatio, /* ---- 批次进价 / 售价 ---- */ cid_cost.price_value AS lotCostPrice, cid_sale.price_value AS lotSalePrice, cid_cost.price_value * inv.quantity AS lineCostTotal, cid_sale.price_value * inv.quantity AS linePriceTotal FROM wkf_inventory_item inv LEFT JOIN adm_location loc ON loc.id = inv.location_id AND loc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN cus_supplier sup ON sup.id = inv.supplier_id AND sup.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN med_medication_definition med ON inv.item_table = 'med_medication_definition' AND med.id = inv.item_id AND med.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_device_definition dev ON inv.item_table = 'adm_device_definition' AND dev.id = inv.item_id AND dev.is_deleted 'LOT_NUMBER_COST' AND cid_cost.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_charge_item_definition cid_sale ON cid_sale.instance_table = inv.item_table AND cid_sale.instance_id = inv.item_id AND cid_sale.lot_no =
